_readme: Copy to .llm-connector.json in your project (or ~/). Roles follow the deciding-vs-doing split: plan/verify get reasoning-capable models, build/fast get cheap executors. Each role is an ORDERED fallback list: first entry preferred; anthropic-type entries whose API key env var is unset are skipped; on failure the next entry is tried. Never falls through across roles. Provider types: 'anthropic' (any Anthropic-compatible HTTP endpoint: baseUrl + apiKeyEnv) or 'codex-cli' (OpenAI via the official Codex CLI on your ChatGPT subscription: npm install -g @openai/codex, then codex login). Family separation, mirroring Pi's model-roles: openai-codex never appears in build, so test/verify stay a different model family than the implementer. Trust model: a project-local copy may only use endpoint origins already declared in ~/.llm-connector.json and may not override the codex command; apiKeyEnv must end in API_KEY everywhere.
